The reactor should go critical and blow, taking this ship and all these blasted fighters with it.|Ru Murleen|<ref name="Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Beam focusers''' were a component of the [[Reactor/Legends|main reactor]] on [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]]. During an infiltration mission aboard the ''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought ''Terror'', [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Rookie One]] and [[Ru Murleen]] destroyed the beam focusers in the ship's reactor, causing it to go critical and explode.
